english: Now Peter and John went up together to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
chiru: Khan Peter le John na riethiengmun ah nikna pha nidan `thum hin riethiengmun ah ruhawng uh.

english: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms from those who entered the temple;
chiru: Unu vawn shung ah put ah kekhawr miring `khat vak chawi uh. Makha riethiengmun ah alut hai dieng numpokpek nikna rang, Metha iti riethiengmun pakawt khan ningthingkip rutet uh.

english: who, seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, asked for alms.
chiru: Peter le John na riethiengmun lut rang a rasham u kha rumuk phakhan, numpokpek kha runik a ruawm.

english: And fixing his eyes on him, with John, Peter said, Look at us.
chiru: Peter le John na enrep a ruti uh, Kieini hi ne`en roh.

english: So he gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
chiru: Ih `khat kumuk rangnih ti jarkhan, amani kha rumiejierep.

english: Then Peter said, Silver and gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk.
chiru: Inia Peter na ruti, Kiei na rangkachak le dangka kha niei mi`ing, inia kiniei hi kinepek inih: Nazareth Jesu Christa riming a thoi tana lawn rang roh.

english: And he took him by the right hand and lifted him up, and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
chiru: Peter na ama khut chang khan rurak a rumothoi, khan relentak a eke hai le ekeartui hai kha hawng ngar pe joi.

english: So he, leaping up, stood and walked and entered the temple with them - walking, leaping, and praising God.
chiru: Ama na hawng chawm a hawng ding le roroia rulawn joi. Khan chawmlam a amani le lawn a Pathien mapaklam a riethiengmun khan rulut joi.

english: And all the people saw him walking and praising God.
chiru: Khan lawnlam a Pathien imapak kha mi kholok na rumuk uh.

english: Then they knew that it was he who sat begging alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
chiru: Khan ama kha riethiengmun Metha Pakawt ah rushuthiei khutdawpa kha inih, iti kha amani na rujet uh. Ama chung a ashok khan erekhek a shindawngna runiei uh.

english: Now as the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch which is called Solomon's, greatly amazed.
chiru: Kekhawrpa kha na Peter le John kha irumukui le roroia, mi kholok na, shindawngtak a, Solomon shumkung iti khan ah awm amani dieng rutan uh.

english: So when Peter saw it, he responded to the people: Men of Israel, why do you marvel at this? Or why look so intently at us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
chiru: Peter na mahi rumuk phakhan, mi hai dieng khan rumashang, Aw Israel miring hai, ijar a mahi chung hin shindawngna nanginiei u maw nih? Ninawkle, karanak ua ninawkle kirichichawina u khan a ama hi kimawlawn u ang a, ijar a nine`enrep u maw nih?

english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, glorified His Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let Him go.
chiru: Abraham Pathien, Isaac Pathien, Jacob Pathien, pilepu hai Pathien kha na ama shok Jesu kha rumulur joi. Ama kha Pilate na rumoshok jawt phakhan, nangni na Pilate maikung a nangirujawt boi ua, mi hai dieng a nangirupek u kha inih.

english: But you denied the Holy One and the Just, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
chiru: Inia nangni na Riethieng le Midik kha rujawt u makche a mithatpa kha nangni rang moshokna rang, nangrunik uh.

english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, of which we are witnesses.
chiru: Khan nangni na ringna apeh Rengshapa kha nangruthat uh. Pathien na ama kha athi ah put ah rumothoi. Mahin kieini na kungkachang uh.

english: And His name, through faith in His name, has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which comes through Him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
chiru: Ama riming a takashawntak kha na nangimuk u le nangijet u miringpa hi imarat inih. Khan Jesu dieng ama takashawn kha na nang kholok maikung a miringpa hi amadamna joi.

english: Yet now, brethren, I know that you did it in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
chiru: Tun uliennai hai, nang rampo hai na iruthaw u kha ang a, nangni na jet boi a niruthaw u inih, iti kha kejet.

english: But those things which God foretold by the mouth of all His prophets, that the Christ would suffer, He has thus fulfilled.
chiru: Hitihin Pathien na ama thiempulien hai kholok ner a irurophongna, makhala Christa kha ashawngir rang a inih, iti kha hawng shok nih joi.

english: Repent therefore and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord,
chiru: Khajarkhan nang mulung lek u roh, khan jir u roh. Khanitatu Pathien na nang munu u hai kholok kha nurushuk pe rangnih. Makha pha khan Pumi ah put ah matharnaret pha kha jong rangnih.

english: and that He may send Jesus Christ, who was preached to you before,
chiru: Khan nangni dieng matieng a irurophong Jesu Christa kha jong tir rangnih.

english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God has spoken by the mouth of all His holy prophets since the world began.
chiru: Nieinak kholok hawng mikir masheng, Jesu kha ravan a awmngir rang a inih. Makha chungchanga Pathien na manmieshie put mala a ama thiempulien riethieng hai ner a irurieina inih.

english: For Moses truly said to the fathers, The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from your brethren. Him you shall hear in all things, whatever He says to you.
chiru: Ajarla Moses na pilepu hai dieng diktak a iruriei inih, Nang PUMI nang Pathien na kiei a`ang Thiempulien `khat nang miring ah put ah mothoi rangnih. Nangni dieng a iriei kholok kha nangirangai u rang a shok.

english: And it shall be that every soul who will not hear that Prophet shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.
chiru: Khan makha Thiempulien chawng rangai boi mi rikip kha mi hai kar ah put ah mathang rangnih.

english: Yes, and all the prophets, from Samuel and those who follow, as many as have spoken, have also foretold these days.
chiru: Samuel ah put ah anujui thiempulien kholok na hihai nikho chungchanga irurophongmasha inih.

english: You are sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.
chiru: Khan nangni hi thiempulien hai nai hai kha nangnih uh. Pathien na nangpa hai dieng irupek rawjawtna nai hai kha nangnih uh. Abraham dieng ruti, Nang chicha jar a rieliei a inshungkhur kholok dieng rahvan pek rangnih.

english: To you first, God, having raised up His Servant Jesus, sent Him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your iniquities.
chiru: Pathien na ama shok Jesu kha rumothoi shole, akhat changna a ama kha nangni dieng rahvan pek rang jong tir joi. Makha nang kholok kha nang thatna boi uah put ah niemiehieina u rang a inih.
